Buffer is a social media workspace for scheduling posts, replying to comments and seeing what works [3]. VEXI makes and posts your social content. They overlap on scheduling, and in many ways they fit together.

Buffer calls itself your social media workspace: it schedules posts to Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, Threads, Bluesky, YouTube Shorts, Pinterest, Google Business, Mastodon, X and Substack, helps you reply to comments, and shows what works [3]. Its AI Assistant helps you brainstorm ideas, rewrite content and craft posts for each platform, and using it is optional [4]. Buffer has a free plan for up to 3 channels, and paid plans priced per channel: Essentials from $6 and Team from $12 a channel a month on monthly billing, or $5 and $10 billed yearly, with a 14-day free trial [1][2].

VEXI (formerly Social Realtr) is an AI content studio that runs social media for entrepreneurs and creators. You describe what you want and it makes the posts, videos, designs and captions, then schedules and publishes them. Plans start at $199 a month, and every plan starts with a 15-day trial.
